filesystem: overlay, same /workspace mount for inputs and exports; warm filesystem cache; no exclusive-host claim

memory_observation.limitation: cgroup memory.max and cpu.max unavailable in this sandbox; proc memory is an observation, not a proven enforced container limit

cache_policy: Warm filesystem cache; no fsync, cache drop, power-state tuning or cold-reset; same host/session with coordinated absence of agent builds/tests during timed series; no exclusive-host guarantee.
